answer: A farm of 320 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in fable, queued in dune, and thread publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 63 identities per epoch. A farm of 1563 identities would post 2894 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
